packageRules.description: Majors get no merge-ok and no automerge: they come to the Kernel Coordinator for review.
Updates to files under .github/ (workflow and action pins, reusable shared-web workflows) can touch reviewer paths: no merge-ok and no automerge, so they come to the Kernel Coordinator.
wasix-python and its py-* extension packages are built against one CPython: they bump together, in one PR, so a new numpy never meets the old python (#1180, #1181).
